name: class-interact
description: ClassInteract — real-time interactive presentations: quizzes, polls, word clouds and more, in one session.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
